fallback_positions: Electronic signatures via established e-signature platforms where counterparty confirms signatory's authority in writing
Single signatory from the counterparty if they provide evidence of signing authority (e.g., power of attorney, board resolution)
red_line: Counterparty's signatory authority cannot be verified
escalation_logic: Any doubt about the counterparty's signatory authority
rationale: Ensures NDA is legally binding and enforceable
